editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher, review, patch-note and wiki text is never copied; stories are explained in Swoon'd's own words with a link to the original.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow what I tell her about the games I play, ask about them without faking anything, pick something we can play together, and say 'okay, I get why you love this'.

licensingConstraints.constraint: No game screenshots, key art, box art, character art, UI captures or fan art. Original Swoon'd illustrations only (licence original-swoond): generic HUDs, abstract genre mock-ups and controller silhouettes that resemble no specific game.
No game music, sound effects or voice. Any listening-id clip is original synthesized audio (original-swoond).
No embedded trailers, gameplay, streamer clips or esports broadcasts; deep-link to official channels only.

Game, publisher, platform and esports-team names appear as plain text facts only; no logos. Platform button symbols (for example PlayStation shapes) are described in text and never drawn; controller diagrams label buttons by position.
Never copy review text, patch notes, publisher descriptions or wiki text (even CC BY-SA sources); paraphrase, cite and link.

IGDB is free only for non-commercial use (commercial needs a partner agreement); RAWG needs attribution with an active link and has size limits and no redistribution; Liquipedia is CC BY-SA 3.0 with a non-commercial free API and rate limits; PandaScore is paid per game and bars betting use; Steam Web API terms and rate limits apply. No unofficial or scraped APIs (SteamDB, HowLongToBeat, Metacritic). All accessed only through Swoon'd adapters. Verify each before use.
Players, streamers and developers appear by name as public facts only; no likeness, avatars, quotes or endorsement implication.
Talk about works, never redistribute them (spec section 40). Recommendations use Swoon'd's own descriptions; ratings and mature content are flagged in plain text; no review scores are reproduced.

safetyConstraints: Gambling-like mechanics (loot boxes, gacha, skin betting) are explained neutrally with consumer-protection framing; never simulated, promoted or linked to betting.
Health and wellbeing content stays generic and mainstream (take breaks, sleep, posture); no medical or addiction claims; never frame 'she plays a lot' as a problem to fix.
Online safety: teach mute, report, block and not sharing personal information; toxicity scenarios teach de-escalation, never retaliation.
Age ratings: recommendations flag rating and content in plain text and never steer a minor to mature-rated games.
Never encourage the learner to fake skill, ownership or expertise with the person they care about.
